retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style portrait featuring a central figure seated at an ornate upright piano, illuminated by soft side-lighting from a window, topped with a custom swash-heavy logo in an oval frame.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, moody interior scene centered on a woman in 70s attire sitting at a dark wood upright piano. The lighting is directional, coming from a large window on the right, creating a soft glow on the subject and deep shadows in the room. A prominent oval-framed logo with thick, flowing script sits at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against the dark mass of the piano
Strong horizontal line of the piano keys bisecting the lower third
Vertical window panes providing a rhythmic light source on the right
Top-centered oval logo acting as a formal header
coreInvariants: Muted sepia and warm brown color palette
Ornate wood carving details on the piano

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated centrally, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame, scaled to show full torso and legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy upright piano serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright oval logo, moves down to the subject's face, follows the arm to the piano keys, and is drawn right by the window light.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured wall space above the piano and deep shadows in the lower left corner.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and mahogany browns in the piano and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and pale gold in the subject's clothing and window light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow-gold for the logo outline and lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high range of values from deep blacks to bright window highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated, interlocking swashes on initial and terminal characters
Letters contained within a thin-stroke oval border
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'J' with a deep descending loop
Lowercase 's' and 't' integrated into the flow of the swashes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A tiny, minimalist sans-serif for secondary metadata placed above the main logo.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s era weight and curve style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1970s photograph of a woman with long dark hair seated at a dark, ornate upright piano in a room with wood-paneled walls. Light should stream in from a multi-paned window on the right. Use a warm, sepia-toned color palette with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top-centered oval frame containing custom thick-and-thin swash lettering. The lettering should be cream-colored and tightly packed, filling the oval.

verificationChecks: Is the logo contained in an oval?
Is the lighting directional from a window?
Does the image have a warm, aged photographic quality?
Are the swashes on the lettering exaggerated and fluid?

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between the heavy piano and light window

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible film grain and soft focus
Ensure the logo is perfectly centered at the top
Verify the subject's pose feels natural to the era
Confirm the color palette remains strictly in the warm/brown spectrum
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Ornate Furniture + Directional Window Light + Swash-Script Logo Overlay
